subject: Unable to login
description: User is unable to log in with the correct email and password.

subject: Password reset email not received
description: User requested a password reset but did not receive the reset email.

subject: Application loading slowly
description: The dashboard takes more than 10 seconds to load after signing in.

subject: Payment transaction failed
description: Customer receives an error when attempting to complete a payment.

subject: Profile picture cannot be uploaded
description: Uploading a new profile picture results in an unexpected server error.

subject: Incorrect order status
description: The order has been delivered but is still displayed as processing.

subject: Mobile navigation menu not working
description: The navigation menu does not open when the menu icon is tapped on mobile devices.

subject: Email notifications cannot be disabled
description: User disabled email notifications in settings but continues to receive them.

subject: Duplicate customer records
description: Multiple customer records are being created when the registration form is submitted twice.

subject: Search results are inaccurate
description: Searching for an existing product sometimes returns unrelated products.
